newsitem.title: USA: Reuters and J.J. Kenny Launch Munimarket2.
newsitem.headline: Reuters and J.J. Kenny Launch Munimarket2.

text.p: Reuters America Inc and Standard & Poor Corp's J.J. Kenny Co said Monday they launched MuniMarket2, the second in a series of municipal securities information products the companies are developing.

MuniMarket2 builds on the first MuniMarket service Reuters and Kenny introduced in 1995, which provides real-time news, new issue pricing and calendars, The Blue List, and Kenny Drake Market Data, the companies said in a statement.
MuniMarket2 adds J.J. Kenny's KENNYBASE(R), the comprehensive on-line municipal securities descriptive database.
In addition, MuniMarket2 provides access to KENNYQUOTE(R), which contains current bid-side prices on more than 1.3 million municipal issues, and Kenny NRMSIR Disclosure Services.
The services run on a Microsoft(R) Windows(R) interface called KENNYCONNECTS(R), which provides direct, high-speed delivery to a customer's Reuters Terminal (RT).
A team of journalists from Reuters provides coverage and commentary on news affecting the national and regional municipal markets.
Reuters coverage includes ratings changes, new issues, municipal buy-side interviews, political news and regional economic data.
MuniMarket also includes Reuters Treasury and money market news plus live data contributed by leading brokers.
The key services provided by J.J. Kenny under its agreement with Reuters include:

The Blue List Bond Ticker with real-time, record-based offerings and price changes, The Blue List Bond Broker Wire with page-based bid-wanteds from the 16 top brokers, offerings and dollar bond quotes, and the S&P Municipal One Million Index.

Also included are Kenny Drake Market Data, which provides up to 600 screens of real-time, record-based active dollar bonds, bid wanteds and offerings, and the MSRB Transaction report providing price transparency information on inter-dealer transactions in municipal securities.

J.J. Kenny Co Inc, a unit of Standard & Poor's, which is a division of The McGraw-Hill Companies, is the leading provider of information, evaluation and broker's brokerage services for the municipal securities industry since 1949.
Reuters America Inc is the primary operating division in the Americas of Reuters Holdings PLC , the international news and financial information services group.
